# Links

A URL as a note name: [[https://example.com/docs#install]].

With an alias: [[https://example.com/docs|the docs]].

As an embed: ![[https://example.com/logo.png|Logo]] and ![[https://example.com/logo.png]].

Without a scheme: [[www.example.com]].

With spaces, which a link destination cannot hold bare: [[https://example.com/a b|spaced]].
